summary: End-to-end verification of the 'intuitive flow' iteration. Backend pytest 10/10 passed (/app/backend/tests/test_intuitive_flow.py) including: POST /api/read for paulg/naval/sama returns existing_episode_id (iYPNfdw8/kjitcK2D/f0iQEXPh); POST /api/episodes without fresh returns the existing paulg episode (no new generation); POST /api/episodes with fresh:true for paulg creates a NEW id (itAsQ1Jb) with text_status 'pending'; /api/read for paulg then returns the new pending id (<5 min reuse); new episode becomes ready and GET /api/episodes/{id}/card returns image/jpeg of size 1080x1350 (verified with PIL). Timeline, leaderboard and handle endpoints still return 200 with expected shape. Frontend Playwright: Landing has single hero-handle-input + hero-submit 'Find the episode' with NO 'It's me/It's a friend' tabs; hero-friend-toggle reveals/hides hero-your-handle-input; submitting friend-mode with empty 'you' triggers toast 'Add your own handle too.' Visiting /find?handle=naval -> /ep/kjitcK2D, /find?handle=sama -> /ep/f0iQEXPh, with NO confirm-screen DOM anywhere. /find?handle=paulg redirected to the newest existing episode (itAsQ1Jb, the fresh one I created in backend tests) rather than iYPNfdw8 — the behavior is correct (one episode per handle = most recent), the review-request's expected id is stale. 3-tap fallback works for /find?handle=zzqxnobody9990 (taps-screen rendered, no confirm-screen). Desktop /ep/iYPNfdw8: share-x-btn is a full-width yellow button (width 660px) below title/meta in left col; copy-link-btn + download-btn are small text links beneath; share-count/reroll-btn/report-btn row below; prophecy-lines in right column (x=1116 > 408); episode-secondary with timeline-countdown + prophesy-friend-form + see-all-handle-link sits BELOW the main grid. Mobile 390x844 DOM Y-order is episode-card → episode-meta → prophecy-lines → share-x-btn → episode-secondary (ascending Y confirmed) with no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390). Share dialog: with clipboard-read/write granted, clicking share-x-btn opened share-dialog containing share-dialog-card, share-step-copy 'Card copied' (green check), share-open-x-btn, share-step-paste 'Paste Ctrl+V and post', share-dialog-download, share-dialog-copy-link. Clicking share-open-x-btn opened a popup to https://x.com/intent/tweet?text=The%20Simpsons%20predicted%20%40paulg%20in%201999... step 2 flipped to done and step 3 became active. navigator.clipboard.read() returned types ['image/png']. Copy-link toast 'Link copied. Go cause problems.' displayed and clipboard contained the share_url. Did not run reroll (would consume rate-limited generation).
action_items: No action required. All review-request bullets verified. Note: paulg's 'current' episode is now itAsQ1Jb (fresh gen during this test run); if the main agent wants iYPNfdw8 to remain the canonical paulg episode, the fresh test-generated episodes can be hidden via db.episodes.update({handle_lower:'paulg', id:'itAsQ1Jb'}, {$set:{hidden:true}}).
critical_code_review_comments: server.existing_episode() includes BOTH text_status in ['ready', None] AND text_status=='pending' created_at>=5min — but the $or combines these without re-restricting the pending branch to the 5-min window at the top-level filter. The query as written works (Mongo $or allows per-clause filters), just subtle. Consider renaming the index or adding a comment, and verify behavior under race: two near-simultaneous POST /api/episodes {handle,fresh:false} could both see no existing and both call create_task → two episodes. A unique partial index on handle_lower+text_status=pending would eliminate the race.

ShareBar.toPng creates an ImageBitmap and canvas on page load for the share card (useEffect fires whenever ready becomes true). Harmless, but it does fetch the full card jpeg eagerly on every episode page view, inflating bandwidth. Could defer to shareToX() on desktop as well.

FindFlow.start() does not throttle: if a user hits /find?handle=foo and the backend's read_handle times out at 55s, user waits 55s on the static screen with no cancel. Consider a client-side 'this is taking longer than usual' hint after 15s (currently only exists on the WritingScreen).
seed_data_creation: Created one fresh paulg episode (id itAsQ1Jb) via POST /api/episodes {handle:'paulg', fresh:true}. Shares on iYPNfdw8 incremented by ~2 (share-x click + copy-link click during tests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: paulg's /find now resolves to itAsQ1Jb (newly fresh-generated) instead of iYPNfdw8. Both episodes exist. If a future review requires iYPNfdw8 as the paulg canonical, hide itAsQ1Jb. Rate limit (EPISODES_PER_HOUR=10) used ~1 generation this run. Reroll button not exercised to preserve budget — review request explicitly asked to limit fresh generations. test_intuitive_flow.py reads BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env (not an env var) so it runs regardless of shell env.
